reason: PURE. The first thing I looked at was "fully chelated, no magnesium oxide" and the 200 mg elemental number, then the QR batch report from a named ISO 17025 lab. That is exactly what I check before buying, and a sachet fits in my bag when I travel. I would skip the Complex because it has citrate and citrate upsets my stomach.
objection: I only have the brand's word that the QR report is real until I open one and see the lab name and the magnesium result match the box. I also want to see how it sits on my stomach before I commit to more than one box.
would_change_my_mind: If the QR batch report did not open, did not name the lab, or showed a magnesium number far from 200 mg, I would not buy.
